overview_description.description: Kitch is a food technology company that develops and operates cloud kitchen infrastructure for restaurant and delivery brands. The company provides shared kitchen facilities, online ordering systems, logistics coordination, and operational support to help food businesses expand delivery-focused services without opening traditional dine-in locations. Its platform integrates kitchen management, digital storefronts, and fulfillment processes aimed at streamlining restaurant operations across multiple markets.
